name: quiet-flow-yoga
description: Quiet Flow — a short, guided yoga timer with audible instructions and simple pose visuals. Pick 5, 7, or 10 minutes.

paragraphs: A tiny, dependency-free web app for short, guided practices — like Apple Fitness+'s time-based workouts. Two modes, picked with a tab on the home screen:
Live demo → (also reachable at quiet-flow-yoga.pages.dev) — installable as a home-screen app, and works offline once loaded.
features: Yoga — instructor-led. Pick 5, 7, 10, or 15 minutes and it walks you through a sequence of poses, each one timed and auto-advancing, with a short countdown between them.

Calisthenics — self-paced. Same length picker and overall session clock, but you decide when to move to the next exercise — say "next", swipe, or tap a button — rather than the app timing each one for you.

Zero build step, zero dependencies. Plain HTML/CSS/JS, loaded as ordinary tags (not ES modules), so it works whether you double-click index.html and open it straight from disk, or serve the folder from any static host.…

No copyrighted media. All illustrations are small original SVGs authored for this project. Narration is rendered by Piper, an open-source neural TTS, from MIT-licensed voice models — no voice actor recordings, no…

Responsive for phones. Portrait keeps the usual stacked card layout. In landscape on a phone (short, wide viewport), the workout screen splits into two columns — the pose image on the left, the name/cue/timer/controls…
